QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_walsh_de.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_walsh_definitions (k t : Nat)
  (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) :
  And (∀ (b : Bool), Eq (QuarticQuery.bitSign b) (HPow.hPow (-1) (ite (Eq b true) 1 0)))
    (And
      (∀ (i j : Fin (QuarticQuery.mValue t)),
        Eq (QuarticQuery.walshSign t i j)
          (HPow.hPow (-1)
            ((Finset.range (HMul.hMul 2 t)).sum fun b => ite (Eq (((↑i).testBit b).and ((↑j).testBit b)) true) 1 0)))
      (And
        (∀ (i j : Fin (QuarticQuery.mValue t)),
          Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.H t i j)
            (HMul.hMul (Inv.inv (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)).sqrt) ↑(QuarticQuery.walshSign t i j)))
        (And
          (∀ (i : Fin (QuarticQuery.mValue t)),
            Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.u t i) (Inv.inv (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)).sqrt))
          (∀ (h : Fin k),
            Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.signDiag z h)
              (Matrix.diagonal fun i => ↑(QuarticQuery.bitSign (z (Prod.mk h i))))))))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_equation.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_equation_3 (k t : Nat) (hk : LE.le 1 k)
  (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) :
  And
    (Eq (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z)
      (dotProduct (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.u t)
        ((QuarticQuery.Forrelation.alternate (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.H t)
              (List.ofFn fun h => QuarticQuery.Forrelation.signDiag z h)).mulVec
          (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.u t))))
    (Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) (HPow.hPow 2 (Neg.neg (HMul.hMul 5 ↑k))))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_equation_4 (k t : Nat) (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) :
  And (Eq (Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (HMul.hMul k (QuarticQuery.mValue t)))
    (And
      (Iff (Eq (QuarticQuery.P k t z) (some true)) (LE.le (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z)))
      (And
        (Iff (Eq (QuarticQuery.P k t z) (some false))
          (LE.le (abs (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z)) (HDiv.hDiv (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) 2)))
        (And
          (Iff (Eq (QuarticQuery.P k t z) none)
            (And (Not (LE.le (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z)))
              (Not (LE.le (abs (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z)) (HDiv.hDiv (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) 2)))))
          (Not
            (And (LE.le (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z))
              (LE.le (abs (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z)) (HDiv.hDiv (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) 2)))))))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_projecti.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_projection_test (k t : Nat) (hk : LE.le 1 k) :
  And
    (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)),
      And (Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.successProb z) (HPow.hPow (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z) 2))
        (And
          (Eq (QuarticQuery.P k t z) (some true) →
            LE.le (HPow.hPow (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) 2) (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.successProb z))
          (Eq (QuarticQuery.P k t z) (some false) →
            LE.le (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.successProb z)
              (HDiv.hDiv (HPow.hPow (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) 2) 4))))
    (And (QuarticQuery.Upper.Samples k fun z b => QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (HPow.hPow (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z) 2) b)
      (∀ [inst : Inhabited (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)],
        QuarticQuery.Upper.Runs (HMul.hMul 2 k) fun z b =>
          QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (HPow.hPow (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z) 2) b))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_bitOracl.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_bitOracle_phase_kickback {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {w : Nat} (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput ι)
  (ψ : QuarticQuery.State ι w)
  (hminus :
    ∀ (i : ι) (z : Fin (HAdd.hAdd w 1)),
      Eq (ψ.ofLp (Prod.mk i (Prod.mk true z))) (Neg.neg (ψ.ofLp (Prod.mk i (Prod.mk false z)))))
  (p : QuarticQuery.Basis ι w) :
  Eq ((QuarticQuery.bitOracle x ψ).ofLp p) (HMul.hMul (ite (Eq (x p.1) true) (-1) 1) (ψ.ofLp p))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_bitOracle_phase_preserves {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {w : Nat} (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput ι)
  (ψ : QuarticQuery.State ι w)
  (hminus :
    ∀ (i : ι) (z : Fin (HAdd.hAdd w 1)),
      Eq (ψ.ofLp (Prod.mk i (Prod.mk true z))) (Neg.neg (ψ.ofLp (Prod.mk i (Prod.mk false z)))))
  (hunit : Eq (norm ψ) 1) :
  And (Eq (norm (QuarticQuery.bitOracle x ψ)) 1)
    (∀ (i : ι) (z : Fin (HAdd.hAdd w 1)),
      Eq ((QuarticQuery.bitOracle x ψ).ofLp (Prod.mk i (Prod.mk true z)))
        (Neg.neg ((QuarticQuery.bitOracle x ψ).ofLp (Prod.mk i (Prod.mk false z)))))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_lemma_2_.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_lemma_2_1_ii_complete (k : Nat) (hk : LE.le 1 k) :
  Exists fun A =>
    And (LT.lt 0 A)
      (∀ (t : Nat) (η : Real),
        LT.lt 0 η →
          LT.lt η (1 / 2) →
            Exists fun n =>
              Exists fun L =>
                Exists fun Z =>
                  Exists fun instZ =>
                    have x := instZ;
                    Exists fun o =>
                      Exists fun out =>
                        Exists fun F =>
                          And
                            (LE.le (↑(HMul.hMul 2 (HMul.hMul n k)))
                              (HMul.hMul A (HAdd.hAdd 1 (Real.log (HDiv.hDiv 1 η)))))
                            (And (QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (HMul.hMul n k) F)
                              (And
                                (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (b : Bool),
                                  Eq (L z b) (QuarticQuery.Upper.lawOf ((F z) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket o)) out b))
                                (And
                                  (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)),
                                    And (LE.le 0 (L z false))
                                      (And (LE.le 0 (L z true)) (Eq (HAdd.hAdd (L z false) (L z true)) 1)))
                                  (And
                                    (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (b : Bool),
                                      Eq (QuarticQuery.P k t z) (some b) → LE.le (HSub.hSub 1 η) (L z b))
                                    (Exists fun instI =>
                                      have x_1 := instI;
                                      Exists fun w =>
                                        Exists fun emb =>
                                          Exists fun K =>
                                            ∀
                                              (next :
                                                QuarticQuery.AdaptiveProgram (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t) w),
                                              And
                                                (LE.le (K next).queryCap
                                                  (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 (HMul.hMul n k)) next.queryCap))
                                                (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))
                                                  (ψ : QuarticQuery.Upper.Reg Z) (b : Bool),
                                                  Eq ((K next).outputMass z ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ψ) b)
                                                    (next.outputMass z ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ((F z) ψ))
                                                      b))))))))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_N_phi.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_N_phi (k t : Nat) (hk : LE.le 1 k)
  (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) :
  And
    (Eq (↑(QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator k t z))
      (dotProduct (fun x => 1)
        ((QuarticQuery.Forrelation.alternate (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.W t)
              (List.ofFn fun h => QuarticQuery.Forrelation.signDiag z h)).mulVec
          fun x => 1)))
    (And
      (Eq (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z)
        (HDiv.hDiv ↑(QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator k t z) ↑(QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t)))
      (And (LT.lt 0 (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t))
        (And
          (Eq (↑(QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t))
            (HMul.hMul (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)) (HPow.hPow (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)).sqrt (HSub.hSub k 1))))
          (And
            (Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.W t)
              (HSMul.hSMul (↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)).sqrt (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.H t)))
            (∀ (i j : Fin (QuarticQuery.mValue t)),
              Or (Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.W t i j) 1) (Eq (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.W t i j) (-1)))))))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_integer_.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_integer_tests (k t : Nat)
  (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) :
  And
    (Iff (LE.le (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z))
      (GE.ge (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 (HMul.hMul 5 k)) (QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator k t z))
        (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t)))
    (And
      (Iff (LE.le (abs (QuarticQuery.Phi k t z)) (HDiv.hDiv (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.delta k) 2))
        (LE.le (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 5 k) 1)) (abs (QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator k t z)))
          (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t)))
      (And
        (Iff (QuarticQuery.promised (QuarticQuery.P k t) z)
          (Or
            (GE.ge (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 (HMul.hMul 5 k)) (QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator k t z))
              (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t))
            (LE.le
              (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 5 k) 1)) (abs (QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator k t z)))
              (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t))))
        (Iff (Eq (QuarticQuery.P k t z) (some true))
          (GE.ge (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 (HMul.hMul 5 k)) (QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator k t z))
            (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator k t)))))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_forr_out.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_forr_output_bits (l t : Nat)
  (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t))
  (tr : Fin (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.forrCircuit l t).size → Bool)
  (htr : QuarticQuery.GateConsistent (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.forrCircuit l t) x tr) :
  And
    (Eq (tr (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.forrCircuit l t).valueOut)
      (decide
        (GE.ge
          (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 (HMul.hMul 5 (HAdd.hAdd l 1)))
            (QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t x))
          (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t))))
    (Eq (tr (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.forrCircuit l t).domainOut)
      (decide
        (Or
          (GE.ge
            (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 (HMul.hMul 5 (HAdd.hAdd l 1)))
              (QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t x))
            (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t))
          (LE.le
            (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 5 (HAdd.hAdd l 1)) 1))
              (abs (QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t x)))
            (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t)))))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_circuit_.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_circuit_costs (l t : Nat) (ht : LE.le 1 t) :
  And
    (LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.widthTop l t) 1)
      (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 3 l) 5) (HMul.hMul 2 t)))
    (And
      (∀ (w : Nat),
        LE.le (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.whtCost w (HMul.hMul 2 t))
          (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul 2 t) (QuarticQuery.mValue t)) (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 6 w) 1)))
      (And
        (∀ (n w : Nat),
          LE.le (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.layerCost n w l)
            (HAdd.hAdd 1
              (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd l 1)
                (HAdd.hAdd (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.whtCost w n) (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 n) (HMul.hMul 6 w))))))
        (And
          (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t)),
            LE.le (abs (QuarticQuery.forrelationNumerator (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t x))
              (QuarticQuery.forrelationDenominator (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t))
          (And
            (QuarticQuery.CircuitRealises (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.forrCircuit l t) (QuarticQuery.P (HAdd.hAdd l 1) t))
            (LE.le (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.forrCircuit l t).size
              (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.forrConstant (HAdd.hAdd l 1)) (QuarticQuery.mValue t))
                (HPow.hPow (HMul.hMul 2 t) 2)))))))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_walkN_bo.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_walkN_bound (n l : Nat) (σ : Nat → Nat → Int)
  (hσ : ∀ (h i : Nat), LE.le (abs (σ h i)) 1) (i : Nat) :
  LE.le (abs (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.walkN n l σ i)) (HPow.hPow (↑(HPow.hPow 2 n)) l)

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_walkN_pr.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_walkN_prefix_bound (n l a : Nat) (σ : Nat → Nat → Int)
  (hσ : ∀ (h i : Nat), LE.le (abs (σ h i)) 1) :
  LE.le (abs ((Finset.range a).sum fun j => QuarticQuery.Forrelation.walkN n l σ j))
    (HMul.hMul (↑a) (HPow.hPow (↑(HPow.hPow 2 n)) l))

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_butterfl.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_butterfly_block_bound (q i offset : Nat) (v : Nat → Int) (B : Int)
  (hv : ∀ (j : Nat), LT.lt j (HPow.hPow 2 q) → LE.le (abs (v (HAdd.hAdd offset j))) B) :
  LE.le
    (abs
      ((Finset.range (HPow.hPow 2 q)).sum fun j =>
        HMul.hMul (QuarticQuery.Forrelation.walshN q i j) (v (HAdd.hAdd offset j))))
    (HMul.hMul (↑(HPow.hPow 2 q)) B)

QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_lemma_2_.type_printout:
QuarticQuery.Paper.construction_lemma_2_1_complete (k : Nat) (hk : LE.le 2 k) :
  And (Exists fun t₀ => ∀ (t : Nat), LE.le t₀ t → LT.lt (QuarticQuery.Lvalue k t) (QuarticQuery.R (QuarticQuery.P k t)))
    (And
      (Exists fun A =>
        And (LT.lt 0 A)
          (∀ (t : Nat) (η : Real),
            LT.lt 0 η →
              LT.lt η (1 / 2) →
                Exists fun n =>
                  Exists fun L =>
                    Exists fun Z =>
                      Exists fun instZ =>
                        have x := instZ;
                        Exists fun o =>
                          Exists fun out =>
                            Exists fun F =>
                              And
                                (LE.le (↑(HMul.hMul 2 (HMul.hMul n k)))
                                  (HMul.hMul A (HAdd.hAdd 1 (Real.log (HDiv.hDiv 1 η)))))
                                (And (QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (HMul.hMul n k) F)
                                  (And
                                    (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (b : Bool),
                                      Eq (L z b) (QuarticQuery.Upper.lawOf ((F z) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket o)) out b))
                                    (And
                                      (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)),
                                        And (LE.le 0 (L z false))
                                          (And (LE.le 0 (L z true)) (Eq (HAdd.hAdd (L z false) (L z true)) 1)))
                                      (And
                                        (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (b : Bool),
                                          Eq (QuarticQuery.P k t z) (some b) → LE.le (HSub.hSub 1 η) (L z b))
                                        (Exists fun instI =>
                                          have x_1 := instI;
                                          Exists fun w =>
                                            Exists fun emb =>
                                              Exists fun K =>
                                                ∀
                                                  (next :
                                                    QuarticQuery.AdaptiveProgram (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t) w),
                                                  And
                                                    (LE.le (K next).queryCap
                                                      (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 2 (HMul.hMul n k)) next.queryCap))
                                                    (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))
                                                      (ψ : QuarticQuery.Upper.Reg Z) (b : Bool),
                                                      Eq ((K next).outputMass z ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ψ) b)
                                                        (next.outputMass z ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ((F z) ψ))
                                                          b)))))))))
      (Exists fun S =>
        And (LT.lt 0 S)
          (∀ (t : Nat),
            LE.le 1 t →
              Exists fun C =>
                And (QuarticQuery.CircuitRealises C (QuarticQuery.P k t))
                  (LE.le (↑C.size)
                    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul ↑S ↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t))
                      (HPow.hPow (Real.logb 2 ↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t)) 2))))))
